# scaffolding_node_disk_lvm (Resource)

Manages an LVM volume group on a Proxmox VE node. PVE does not support in-place LVM VG reconfigure, so any non-key attribute change forces replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `devices` (List of String) Devices to use as physical volumes for the new VG.
- `name` (String) Volume group name.
- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Also create a storage entry for the VG in PVE.
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) When deleting the VG, also remove the storage entry PVE created when `add_storage=true` was set. Defaults to `true`.
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) When deleting the VG, also wipe the underlying PVs. Defaults to `true`; set to `false` to keep the disks for inspection.
